observations.behavior: Adds a new endpoint configuration named activity_events with primary keys person_id and activity_id derived from JSON:API relationships.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines warehouse ingestion parameters that establish composite identity and temporal grain without requiring an explicit id field on each row.

observations.behavior: Selects either the existing item flattener or a newly added relationship-based flattener depending on whether relationship fields are configured.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes how rows are transformed during warehouse import to promote foreign key identifiers out of nested relationship objects into root columns.

observations.behavior: Tests that the relationship flattener correctly extracts IDs from nested relationship data and assigns them as top-level attributes while preserving missing values as None.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides test coverage for the transformation behavior, including edge cases where relationships are absent or incomplete, supporting reliable downstream queries.

observations.limitations: All hunks pertain exclusively to Northpass LMS warehouse connector implementation; no changes appear in PostHog core query execution, shared ORM, authentication, billing, or other systemic components. No tests cover failure recovery, retry handling, deduplication across runs, or compatibility with other warehouse sources.

review.limitations: All hunks pertain exclusively to Northpass LMS warehouse connector implementation; no changes appear in PostHog core query execution, shared ORM, authentication, billing, or other systemic components. No tests cover failure recovery, retry handling, deduplication across runs, or compatibility with other warehouse sources.
review.reason: Adds bounded capability: a new warehouse ingestion endpoint and its associated identity extraction and schema configuration. The change is substantive because it introduces a composite primary key without an explicit id field, requiring a dedicated flattening utility and corresponding unit tests. It does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or cross-component dependency changes required for tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant only if warehouse connectors are used by customers importing Northpass learning events. This chunk alone cannot establish adoption or benefit; relevance depends on whether this source is enabled and connected in production.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on customer use of the Northpass connector and successful end-to-end import and querying, none of which can be inferred from this chunk.
